summary: GrafTech International Ltd. filed an 8-K disclosing an Equity Distribution Agreement with Evercore Group L.L.C. for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $50 million of common stock. Shares will be sold at the Company's discretion via ordinary broker transactions, with Evercore receiving a 3% commission. Net proceeds are targeted for general corporate purposes including debt refinancing and potential acquisitions. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation. No stakeholder change, activist involvement, or strategic transformation is present. The filing contains no categorization triggers for acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring.
